evidence_quotes: Randvoorwaardenkorting, artikel 5 Besluit gebruik meststoffen, niet emissiearm aanwenden
rationale: The decision concerns an agricultural CAP cross-compliance subsidy reduction (Randvoorwaardenkorting) for failing to apply manure in a low-emission manner under Article 5 of the Dutch Besluit gebruik meststoffen, along with administrative hearing obligations under the Awb. Agricultural manure/fertilizer regulation is not substantively about water law or water governance.
